senses.gloss: उत्तिङ्ग m. a species of insect, Kalpas.; Jain.
a partic. insect, Śīl.
उत्-√ तिज् (उद्-√ तिज्), Caus. P. -तेजयति, to excite, stimulate, incite, instigate, animate, encourage, Kathās.; Mṛcch. &c.
उत्-तीरम् ind. on the shore, Kir.
उत्-तीर्ण See col. 3.
उत्-तीर्ण mfn. landed, crossed, traversed
rescued, liberated, escaped
released from obligation
thrown off
one who has completed his studies, experienced, clever.
उत्-तितीर्षु mfn. about to pass out of (water), wishing to land, MBh.
उत्-तीर्ण—विकृति mfn. one who has escaped any change, NṛsUp.
उत्-तीर्य ind.p. having crossed, having landed &c.
उत्-तिष्ठासा f. the intention to leave off
the wish to leave (a sacrifice &c.) unfinished, Nyāyam.
1. ऊति॑ इस्, f. help, protection, promoting, refreshing favour
kindness, refreshment, RV.; AV.
means of helping or promoting or refreshing, goods, riches (also plur.), RV.; AV.; ŚBr. xii
enjoyment, play, dalliance, BhP. viii, 5, 44
= क्षरण, T.
2. ऊति॑ इस्, f. the act of weaving, sewing, L.
red texture
tissue, BhP. ii, 10, 1
a mole's hole, TBr. i, 1, 3, 3.
3. ऊति m. (for 1. and 2. see 3. and 4. ऊ above), N. of a Daitya, SkandaP.
ऊति॑ See 1. ऊत &c., p. 221, col. 1.
ऊति—मती॑ f. (scil. ऋच्) N. of a Ṛc (RV. i, 30, 7) which contains the word ऊति, MaitrS.
the verse RV. i, 30, 7, MaitrS.
ऊतीक m. N. of a plant which can be substituted for the Soma (cf. पूतीक), Kāṭh.; TāṇḍyaBr.
